items.title: Adobe Commerce Account Takeover via Session Identity Flaw
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch an active session to another customer account, leading to account takeover. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass in Adobe Commerce. This flaw requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce & Magento Security Update – July 2026
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356), improper output encoding leading to arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-48358), stored XSS for privilege escalation (CVE-2026-47994), and incorrect authorization issues enabling security feature bypass (CVE-2026-47988, CVE-2026-47984).

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 7.5) in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered the PolyShell vulnerability, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12, 2026.
